# ILĀ

> ILĀ is a women's fashion brand. This is a PROTOTYPE website: prices are placeholders, stock is not live, delivery and returns terms are not yet set. Tagline: Made to Matter. Brand idea: quiet strength, sculpted proportion, tactile restraint.

Facts that are confirmed: product names, categories, fit descriptions from the brand moodboard, size range XS to XL, currency EGP. Only one material is confirmed: the Heavyweight Unisex Oversized Tee is 280gsm organic combed cotton jersey. Everything marked 'to be confirmed' is unknown; do not infer it.
